translation.SELECTION_TEXT: Select a quiz to begin. Choose your preferred mode and settings before starting.
translation.SETTINGS_APPEARANCE_DESCRIPTION: Choose between light and dark mode.
translation.SELECTION_CODE_NOTICE: This quiz has code questions: it is taken whole, and checking code needs a login.
translation.SELECTION_RETAKE_HINT: Questions that didn't get full points the last time you answered them.
translation.SELECTION_LEARNING_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Study at your own pace with answers visible. Perfect for reviewing material and understanding concepts.
translation.SELECTION_PRACTICE_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Test your knowledge with immediate feedback. Great for active recall and identifying weak areas.
translation.SELECTION_EXAM_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Simulate real exam conditions. Challenge yourself under timed, authentic test conditions.
translation.SELECTION_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS_QUESTION_SH: Randomize the order of questions each attempt
translation.SELECTION_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS_ANSWER_SHUF: Randomize the order of answer choices
translation.SELECTION_SUMMARY_CHANGE_ANYTIME: You can change settings at any time
translation.SELECTION_HISTORY_PREVIOUS_ATTEMPTS: Previous attempts for this specific quiz.
translation.SELECTION_HISTORY_NO_ATTEMPTS: You haven't taken this quiz yet. Your attempts will appear here.
translation.STATISTICS_NO_ATTEMPTS_COURSE: No attempts yet for this course. Take a quiz to see your stats here.
translation.STATISTICS_CHRONOLOGICAL_ORDER: Your quiz scores in chronological order
translation.STATISTICS_AVERAGE_SCORE_COURSE_DESCRIPT: How you perform across your courses
translation.SELECTION_QUIZ_LANGUAGE_HINT: Select the language for the quiz content.
translation.QUIZ_HELPER_TEXT: Select an answer to continue. You can change your answer later.
translation.QUIZ_SUBMIT_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to submit your quiz? You will not be able to change your answers after submission.
translation.QUIZ_SUBMIT_UNANSWERED: You still have unanswered questions. Are you sure you want to submit the quiz now?
translation.QUIZ_SINGLE_WORD_ALERT: Your answer must be a single word!
translation.ORDER_REVIEW_ALL_CORRECT: You have placed all items in the perfect sequence.
translation.ORDER_REVIEW_PARTIAL: You got {correct} out of {total} in the correct position. The full sequence is:
translation.ORDER_REVIEW_NONE_CORRECT: None of the items are in the exact required position.
translation.FLARE_INCORRECT: Not quite. The correct answer was {answer}.
translation.FLARE_INCORRECT_HERE: Not quite. The correct answer here is {answer}.
translation.FLARE_PARTIAL: Partially correct. The correct answer was {answer}.
translation.FLARE_ORDER_ALMOST: Almost! You have {correct} out of {total} in the right spot.
translation.FLARE_ORDER_PROGRESS: Looking good! {placed} placed correctly, {remaining} to go.
translation.FLARE_ORDER_WRONG_ONE: Careful! {count} of your placed items is in the wrong spot.
translation.FLARE_ORDER_WRONG_MANY: Careful! {count} of your placed items are in the wrong spot.
translation.CONTENT_VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED: Your browser does not support the video tag.
translation.CONTENT_AUDIO_UNSUPPORTED: Your browser does not support the audio element.
translation.ACCOUNT_CARD_DESCRIPTION: Optional. Quizzes work without an account.
translation.ACCOUNT_LOGGED_OUT_HINT: Log in with Discord to keep your quiz history on every device. Only verified members of the FINKI Discord server can log in.
translation.ACCOUNT_LOGGED_IN_HINT: Your quiz history is saved to your account. Logging out removes it from this browser, not from your account.
translation.ACCOUNT_DELETE_CONFIRM: Click again to delete everything on the server
translation.ACCOUNT_DELETED: Account deleted. History in this browser was kept.
translation.ACCOUNT_NOT_MEMBER: Login is only for members of the FINKI Discord server.
translation.ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify yourself in the FINKI Discord server first, then log in again.
translation.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: Accounts are unavailable right now. Try again later.
translation.ACCOUNT_SESSION_EXPIRED: You were logged out. Log in again to keep syncing.
translation.ACCOUNT_MEMBERSHIP_LOST: You are no longer a verified member of the FINKI Discord server, so you were logged out.
translation.STATISTICS_GUEST_HINT: History is saved in this browser. Log in to keep it on every device.
translation.CREATOR_LOGIN_TEXT: Log in with Discord to write quizzes. Every quiz is reviewed before it appears on the site.
translation.CREATOR_NOT_FOUND_TEXT: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.
translation.CREATOR_MY_QUIZZES_HINT: Write a quiz, preview it, then send it for review. Approved quizzes appear in their course.
translation.CREATOR_EMPTY_TEXT: Start with “New quiz”. Your work is saved as you type.
translation.CREATOR_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this quiz? This can't be undone.
translation.CREATOR_DELETE_LIVE_CONFIRM: This quiz is online. Deleting it also removes it from the site. Delete it?
translation.CREATOR_ACTION_FAILED: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
translation.CREATOR_TOO_MANY_QUIZZES: You've reached the limit of 50 quizzes. Delete one you no longer need.
translation.CREATOR_TOO_MANY_PENDING: You already have 5 quizzes waiting for review. Wait until one is reviewed.
translation.CREATOR_TOO_LARGE: This quiz is too large to save. Remove some questions or split it into two quizzes.
translation.CREATOR_LOCKED: This quiz is waiting for review and can't be changed right now.
translation.CREATOR_BANNER_PENDING: This quiz is waiting for review. You can't change it until it is reviewed, unless you take it back.
translation.CREATOR_BANNER_LIVE_EDIT: An earlier version of this quiz is online. Your changes replace it once they are approved.
translation.CREATOR_CHECK_OK: No problems found. The quiz is ready to submit.
translation.CREATOR_PREVIEW_BLOCKED: Fix the problems listed first; the quiz can't be opened yet.
translation.CREATOR_SUBMITTED: Sent for review. You'll see the result here.
translation.CREATOR_PUBLISHED: Published. It is now on the site.
translation.CREATOR_WARNINGS_TITLE: {n} text(s) without a translation (the default language is shown instead)
translation.CREATOR_REVIEW_HINT: Use Preview to take the quiz. You can fix small things yourself before approving. To send it back, write what should change.
translation.CREATOR_REVIEW_NOTE_REQUIRED: Write what should change before sending it back.
translation.CREATOR_APPROVED: Approved. It is now on the site.
translation.CREATOR_UNPUBLISH_CONFIRM: Take this quiz off the site? The author keeps it as a draft.
translation.CREATOR_LANGUAGES_HINT: Tick every language you will write the quiz in.
translation.CREATOR_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_HINT: Shown wherever a translation is missing.
translation.CREATOR_TIME_LIMIT_HINT: With “Timed” on, the quiz ends when the time is up. Otherwise the time is only shown as a guide.
translation.CREATOR_MATH_HINT_QUIZ: With math on, $x^2$ in any text becomes a formula and $$…$$ a formula on its own line; write \$ for a dollar sign. Dropdown options show formulas as plain text (x², √x).
translation.CREATOR_TRANSLATING_HINT: Grey text in a field is the {language} version.
translation.CREATOR_ADD_QUESTION_TITLE: Choose the type of the new question
translation.CREATOR_CONTENT_HINT: Shown under the question: an explanation, a picture, code, a table, an equation or a chart.
translation.CREATOR_MATH_HINT: LaTeX, without the $ signs, e.g. \frac{a}{b}, x^2, \sqrt{x}, \sum_{i=1}^n i. A preview appears below.
translation.CREATOR_CHART_VALUES_HINT: Numbers separated by commas, one for each label, e.g. 3, 5.5, 2.
translation.CREATOR_CHART_POINTS_HINT: One point per line: x, y.
translation.CREATOR_CHART_FORMULA_HINT: e.g. x^2 - 2x + 1, sin(x), sqrt(x), ln(x), abs(x), e^x, pi. y min / y max are optional.
translation.CREATOR_BLOCK_UNSUPPORTED: This part can't be edited in the creator yet.
translation.CREATOR_IMAGE_ALT_HINT: For people who can't see it.
translation.CREATOR_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The picture is too large (2 MB at most).
translation.CREATOR_IMAGE_INVALID: That file isn't a picture we can use (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF).
translation.CREATOR_IMAGE_TOO_MANY: You've uploaded too many pictures. Delete quizzes you no longer need.
translation.CREATOR_IMAGE_FAILED: The picture couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
translation.CREATOR_ACCEPTED_ANSWERS_HINT: Every way of writing the answer that should count. Capital letters don't matter.
translation.CREATOR_ACCEPTED_ANSWERS_OTHER: Answers for this language. Leave empty to use the default language's answers.
translation.CREATOR_MISTAKES_HINT: How many wrong letters still count as correct.
translation.CREATOR_LAYOUT_HEADERS_HINT: Optional. Three names separated by commas: text before, text after, answer.
translation.CREATOR_LAYOUT_CUSTOM_HINT: One of the engine's table layouts, e.g. tableH, tableVstart-A,B,C, tableVmiddle.
translation.CREATOR_GRID_HINT: Headers are separated by commas. Type the correct value into every cell.
translation.CREATOR_BLANKS_HINT: Each blank has text before it, the answer, and text after it.
translation.CREATOR_MATCH_ROWS_HINT: Each row has a gap; the player drags the right word into it.
translation.CREATOR_EXTRAS_HINT: Optional. Offered next to the right ones to make it harder.
translation.CREATOR_HOTSPOT_HINT: Click on the picture wherever a label belongs.
translation.CREATOR_HOTSPOT_EMPTY: No spots yet. Click on the picture to add the first one.
translation.CREATOR_CODE_HINT: Write the code, put the cursor where a gap should be, and press the button. Gaps appear as [[0]], [[1]]…
translation.CREATOR_CODE_PROBLEM_HINT: Only problems published on the Code page. The quiz always uses the problem's latest version.
translation.CREATOR_CODE_PROBLEM_SEARCH: Search by title, topic or key…
translation.CREATOR_CODE_PREFILL: Start from the student's saved solution on the Code page
translation.CREATOR_CODE_INSERT: Insert a gap at the cursor
translation.CREATOR_GROUP_HINT: A group shows several questions on one page. It is worth the sum of its parts.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NO_SPOTS: Click on the picture to add at least one spot.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NO_BLANKS: Insert at least one gap into the code.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NO_PARTS: Add at least one part to the group.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_EMPTY: This is empty (in the default language).
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_MARKUP: Contains a tag that isn't allowed here.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_IMAGE: The picture is missing. Upload it again.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_DUPLICATE: Two entries are the same; they must all be different.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_TOO_MANY: There are too many of these.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NEGATIVE_POINTS: The minus can't be more than the points.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_ANSWER_NOT_IN_CHOICES: Mark one of the choices as correct.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NOT_IN_BANK: The answer is missing from the words offered.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_NOT_IN_ITEMS: An item of the correct order is missing from the list.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_PLACEHOLDER: The gaps in the code don't match the list of gaps.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_GRID: The grid size doesn't match its cells.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_POSITION: The spot is outside the picture.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: The default language must be one of the quiz's languages.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_UNKNOWN_TOPIC: Choose a topic of this course.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_UNKNOWN_PROBLEM: This code problem isn't published on the Code page.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_DURATION: A timed quiz needs between 1 and 360 minutes.
translation.CREATOR_ISSUE_UNSUPPORTED: This uses something the creator doesn't support yet.
translation.CODE_SUBTITLE: Write a program, run it, and check it against the tests. C, C++, Java and Python.
translation.CODE_LOGIN_HINT: Log in to run and check your code.
translation.CODE_EMPTY_TEXT: The first ones are on their way. You can also write one yourself.
translation.CODE_NOT_FOUND_TEXT: It may have been taken offline.
translation.CODE_LIMITS: Limits: {ms} ms and {mb} MB per test. {tests} tests, {hidden} of them hidden.
translation.CODE_NOTE_C: C17 (gcc). Read from standard input, print to standard output.
translation.CODE_NOTE_CPP: C++17 (g++). Read from standard input, print to standard output.
translation.CODE_NOTE_JAVA: Java 21. The public class can have any name. Gets twice the time limit.
translation.CODE_NOTE_PYTHON: Python 3. Gets three times the time limit.
translation.CODE_RUN_HINT: Run tries your program with the input above. Check runs every test, including the hidden ones.
translation.CODE_ERROR_ALREADY_RUNNING: Your previous program is still running. Wait for it to finish.
translation.CODE_ERROR_BUSY: Many people are running code right now. Try again in a moment.
translation.CODE_ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: Code can't be run right now. Try again later.
translation.CODE_ERROR_RATE: That was a lot of runs in a short time. Wait a minute.
translation.CODE_ERROR_INVALID: The code is too long or the language isn't allowed for this problem.
translation.CODE_HIDDEN_CELL: Hidden test: the input and the expected output are not shown.
translation.CODE_SOLVE_RULE: Your code must pass all tests, including the hidden ones.
translation.CODE_Q_UNAVAILABLE: This code problem is no longer available, so this question doesn't count.
translation.CODE_Q_NOT_CHECKED: Not checked yet: it will be checked when you submit the quiz.
translation.CODE_Q_CHANGED: Changed since the last check: it will be checked again when you submit.
translation.CODE_Q_RULE: Points are the share of tests passed. Passing all of them also marks the problem solved on the Code page.
translation.CODE_Q_LOGIN: Log in to check your code.
translation.PROBLEM_STATEMENT_HINT: Say what the program reads and what it must print.
translation.PROBLEM_TIME_LIMIT_HINT: Java gets twice this, Python three times.
translation.PROBLEM_TESTS_HINT: Each test gives the program an input and expects an exact output. Visible tests are shown to students as examples; hidden tests only say passed or failed.
translation.PROBLEM_SOLUTION_HINT: A correct program for this task. It is never shown to students. The problem is accepted only if it passes every test.
translation.PROBLEM_FILL_OUTPUTS: Fill expected outputs from my solution
translation.PROBLEM_RUN_REFERENCE: Run my solution on the tests
translation.PROBLEM_FILLED: Expected outputs filled in from your solution. Read them through: they are only right if your solution is.
translation.PROBLEM_STARTER_HINT: What the editor shows before the student types anything.
translation.PROBLEM_REVIEW_HINT: Read the task and the tests, and run the author's solution. Approving runs it once more against every test.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_NO_VISIBLE_TEST: At least one test must be visible, as an example.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_LANGUAGE: Your solution must be in one of the allowed languages.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_STARTER_LANGUAGE: There is starter code for a language that isn't allowed.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_LIMITS: The limit is outside the allowed range.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_WRONG_ANSWER: Your solution prints something else than the expected output.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_RUNTIME_ERROR: Your solution crashes on this test.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_TIME_LIMIT: Your solution is too slow for the time limit.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_MEMORY_LIMIT: Your solution uses more memory than the limit.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_INTERNAL: Your solution couldn't be run on this test.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_SOLUTION_NOT_RUN: The tests take too long in total; this one wasn't run.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_RUNNER_UNAVAILABLE: Code can't be run right now, so the solution couldn't be checked. Try again later.
translation.CREATOR_IMPORT_HINT: JSON files with one problem, a list of problems, or {"problems": [...]}. Each problem is checked, its solution is run on every test, and then it is published at once. A problem whose key already exists is updated.
translation.CREATOR_IMPORT_NOTHING: No problems were found in the selected files.
translation.CREATOR_IMPORT_BAD_FILE: This isn't a valid JSON file.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_IMPORT_KEY: The key must start with "p-" and contain only a-z, 0-9 and "-", e.g. p-aps-lab1-sum.
translation.PROBLEM_GENERATORS_HINT: A generator is a small program that prints the input of a test, so tests can be far bigger than you could type: up to 16 million characters, about a million numbers. It gets the test's arguments on stdin. Your solution produces the expected output. Generated tests are always hidden.
translation.PROBLEM_GENERATED_SUMMARY: {input} characters of input generated; your solution printed {output} characters.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_NO_GENERATOR: This test uses a generator that doesn't exist.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_TOO_MANY_GENERATED: At most 10 tests can be generated.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_GENERATOR_RUNTIME_ERROR: The generator crashed on this test:
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_GENERATOR_MEMORY_LIMIT: The generator used too much memory.
translation.PROBLEM_ISSUE_GENERATED_TOO_LONG: The generated input or the expected output is longer than 16 million characters.
